freeze.digest: sha256 of exact committed protocol bytes, companion plan bytes and binding receipts in an external manifest; no self-reference

units.fold_dates: inclusive first day / exclusive last day, America/New_York regular exchange sessions

boundary.warmup_source: earlier bars within same role only including embargo; extend warmup inside role if needed, retain zero-exposure sessions in returns
boundary.custody_partition_rule: research records require start < cutoff AND end <= cutoff AND received_at < cutoff; research manifest depends only on eligible prefix
boundary.unclosed_or_overdue: invalid; no terminal close assumption, no boundary transfer
boundary.full_hour_definition: Exchange-local clock hour wholly inside one scheduled regular session, exactly four complete consecutive 15m intervals, all available at decision time. Partial opening/closing buckets never count or feed the trend filter.

train: no fitted feature transforms; compute one pair of time-average EUR notional weights by candidate from completed trading intervals for later matched benchmark; no outcome-based pruning

validation_selection.maximize: mean paired daily log excess versus frozen training-exposure passive
validation_selection.tie: rounded to 12 decimals, then ASCII ascending candidate ID

nomination: predeclare selection rule; lock F3 validation winner before viewing ANY fold test returns; identical ID selected by validation at least twice; three noncash fold winners required
passive: one initial purchase per sleeve at feasible raw regular opens with volume cap and frozen evidenced or explicitly modeled costs; target weights fixed then drift, orderly liquidation within same score window; 100% single-instrument portfolios descriptive only
aggregation: chain within-fold normalized observed event-level equity paths in chronological order without resetting the high-water mark; carry cash plus its bound operating costs through gaps; gates on both fold and chained drawdown; inference uses paired scored test sessions only

inference.unit: one common US session; portfolio-level paired daily log returns; no symbol/trade resampling
inference.bootstrap: nonoverlapping folds, within each fold circular moving blocks, synchronized across comparators, truncate final block, pool sessions by count
inference.rng: Python random.Random(seed).randrange(n) per block, fold/date in ascending order
inference.lower_bound: basic one-sided: 2*observed_mean - empirical_quantile(bootstrap_means,1-alpha); quantile is sorted nearest rank ceil(p*B)
inference.alpha: Shadow gate: unadjusted alpha 0.05 on each paired excess, requiring both one-sided lower bounds > 0 in addition to all other research gates.
inference.additional: Exploratory inference on pre-exposed history. Shadow eligibility additionally requires the unchanged confirmatory central gates.

adjusted_reporting.insufficient_resolution: report adjusted LCB as unresolved; never changes the Shadow gate
adjusted_reporting.inventory: Unique attempted same-family US-index-ETF intraday strategy slots across all agents, seeds and versions, including failed or rejected attempts and disclosed unregistered attempts. Record out-of-family exclusions, including DAX and Ollama daily research. Unresolved same-family gaps block freeze.

power_illustration.method: Normal independent-session planning approximation only, not empirical power. Report alpha, approximate Sharpe for 50% and 80% power, and power at the illustrative Sharpe for the unadjusted, adjusted and central bounds. Dependence and the paired comparator can reduce actual power.

budget.accounting: 3*(4 training+4 validation+5 test) times (1 strategy+5 references); log gaps and unexecuted grid cells distinctly; forecasts/previous records count once by identity, one record for each attempted cell including failures; central counted separately

central.baseline: cash and fixed F3 train-matched passive
central.candidate: locked F3 validation ID, parameters and exposure calibration
central.disclose: single fixed aggregate verdict and prelisted metrics to independent decision maker, no interactive queries

access.research_files: Physical research-only export; fetch-intraday and fetch-fx reject an end after [holdout].start. Custodian verifies and records removal of existing local full copies, raw pages, dividends and FX from the research environment and research-only reload. Standard research commands have no authorized path to retrieve the locked suffix.
access.authorization: Separate explicit user release after development gates and exposure attestation. Bind candidate, benchmark, period, inputs, costs and exact code hashes before access.
access.journal: Use one custodian-controlled authoritative durable journal from #23, kind central, budget 1 across all worktrees and invocations. All callers use the same canonical central slot ID fixed in the freeze receipt across invocations. Atomically reserve before any provider request or holdout metadata/payload read. Deny a missing, divergent or unreadable journal. Every reservation consumes the slot, including crash, error, empty data or lost response.
access.retrieval: Only the authorized central batch fetches fresh Alpaca data for the fixed period, plus required window-bound FX from its approved source, after reservation. Never expose raw files to research; no interactive requests.
access.output: Only predeclared aggregate metrics and verdict. Retain authorization, access, hashes and terminal status in the custodian audit without raw market values.

historical_exposure.source: Claude Code method review of PR #22, 2026-11-18
historical_exposure.disclosed: Local full copies included the held-out suffix. Reported exposure: SPY/QQQ dividend amounts and dates from 2025-12 to 2026-09, relative half-session volumes on 2025-11-28 and 2025-12-24, last-bar timestamps and traversal of timestamps for FX coverage.
historical_exposure.not_reported_as_seen: No holdout prices, returns, performance metrics or strategy outcomes reported as seen or computed. This is reported scope, not independently verified custody.
historical_exposure.effect: Custodian must attest the scope and check sources, copies, artifacts, backups and logs. Outcome/selection exposure or unresolved material provenance blocks the central test. Refreshing data does not reset exposure or the budget.

registry.paper_activation: subsequent independent paper operational decision under separately frozen shadow criteria
registry.rollback: disable new entries, reconcile orders and fills, preserve owner/version and protective exits until flat, audit atomic pointer reversal to cash/last approved version

data_requirements.calendar: Bind a historical regular-session calendar for both instruments with full holidays, DST and early closes. Inventory every expected 15-minute slot, fail closed on missing calendar coverage or unexplained discrepancies.
data_requirements.provider_exceptions: Before freeze record symbol, dates, source, evidence, conservative treatment and effect in a manifest. Known SPY dividend gaps 2016-03 and 2018-06 must be independently verified or conservatively treated under an evidenced policy, consistently for candidates and references. Missing pre-2020 payout dates use a fixed documented conservative allowance or a no-cash-until-evidenced policy, independent of held-out data. Document and reconcile the duplicated QQQ ex-date 2022-09-19 without double credit. Unexplained or materially unresolved exceptions block evaluation.
data_requirements.fx: Use causal daily ECB EUR/USD reference mid (#25), maximum age 5 days, fail closed if unavailable or stale, plus separately accounted FX conversion costs from the frozen cost schedule (#28) only on actual modeled conversions. Preserve timestamp, raw mid, age and cost separately.
data_requirements.candidate_evidence: T12/T16 with a 32-bar time stop are untested variants; prior evidence from T-018 used trend without that stop. No candidate parameters or folds changed.
